resolutions.researcher_notes: REDUNDANCY: P4778 ('Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network Phase I, Gao'an-Xinyu', cap=1.00 bcm/y, sheet_row 2667) and P5861 ('West-East Gas Pipeline 2, XinYu Branch(Gao'an-Xinyu)', roster len=69.21km cap=1.00 bcm/y, sheet_row 3325, found in batch_11.json's payload -- flagged as in-scope this pass per this row's own prior_findings) describe the identical route (Gao'an->Xinyu) with the identical capacity figure (1.00 bcm/y), but are attributed to two different GEM pipeline-network parents: 'Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network Phase I' vs. 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2'. I could not resolve this from my own payload alone (P5861's own record is in shard 11's scope, not mine) and did not find independent literature naming a second, separate Gao'an-Xinyu line. Recommend human cross-check against P5861's full record and route geometry (if any) before either row's ref cells are pasted, per the 'findings do not propagate across a fan-out' rule -- not recommending deletion of either row absent that check.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Checked a cross-shard lead (Gao'an-named rows P5861/P4778 filed a reciprocal WEP2-vs-Phase-I misattribution __REDUNDANCY__) against this row. Fetched the 2013 Jiangxi provincial gas plan PDF cited in that lead (pdftotext -layout, not url_verifier's extractor, which misses this CJK PDF's text layer) and independently confirmed two dated facts in it: (1) 川气东送 (Sichuan-East Gas Transmission) began supplying Jiangxi gas 2010-06, feeding the province's 'Phase I' 870km network (6 named trunks: 九江-南昌/九江-沙河/九江-景德镇/南昌-丰城/高安-新余/丰城-抚州 + 田南-上高支线); (2) 西气东输二线 (WEP2) did not begin supplying Jiangxi gas until 2011-09, feeding a separate 98km 'Phase II' network (吉安/赣州/安义 sections + 宜春/萍乡). P4793's own StartYear1=2010-12 predates WEP2's actual first gas delivery to Jiangxi by ~9 months, and instead lines up with the Sichuan-East/Phase-I supply-start window (2010-06), while the row's FuelSource is staged as 'West-East Gas Pipeline' and its wiki section header names it 西气东输二线高余线 (explicitly a WEP2 branch codename) — the two signals conflict. Neither '高安-余江' nor '高余线' appears among the plan document's named Phase I trunks, so I cannot independently confirm this is a Phase I line either (the document's trunk list is prefaced '主要建成' — 'mainly built', i.e. not necessarily exhaustive). The document also states Yingtan (this row's own end city) had NO long-distance pipeline gas as of end-2012, which is at minimum consistent with a phased build (matches this row's own StartYear2=2011/StartYear3=2013 spread) and does not rule out either gas-source story. Net: a genuine, evidence-based tension between the row's StartYear1 and its WEP2/Sichuan-East attribution, of the same shape as the sibling P5861/P4778 finding but NOT as clean-cut (their case had a verbatim trunk-name match in the Phase I list; this row does not). Flagging for human adjudication on FuelSource/parent-network attribution — NOT recommending any value change or row action.

This strongly suggests GEM's 'Shenguili-Pengze Branch' is the downstream continuation of this same officially-named Hukou-Jinshawan-Pengze system, using the Shenguili valve chamber as the segment boundary -- i.e. real infrastructure, correctly in the system, but possibly named/scoped differently than the operator's own section division. Recommend a human check on whether P5886's segment boundaries match how Jiangxi Natural Gas Group itself divides this branch (Hukou-Jinshawan vs Jinshawan/Shenguili-Pengze), since a mismatch there could also explain why the 2022-10 proposal/2022-07 EIA-publicity dates found for 'Shenguili-Pengze' don't line up cleanly with this document's 2016/2017-2021 dates for the adjacent section. Not a duplicate/existence concern -- the pipeline is real and documented; this is a scoping/naming question only. Cross-checked other shards' payloads in this run for any P5886/Shenguili/Pengze/Hukou/Jinshawan mentions -- none found, so no cross-shard corroboration or contradiction to reconcile.

resolutions.researcher_notes: SPEC/CONCERN, new this pass. The Jiangxi provincial 14th-FYP energy-infrastructure project roster (sohu.com, dated 2021, '（三）能源基础设施领域（44项）' itemized list of 44 named projects, opened as one of the 12 previously-unopened harvest_pool_live URLs) lists '广丰支线' (Guangfeng branch) as item 25 and '玉山支线' (Yushan branch) as item 26 -- TWO SEPARATE line items, not one combined 'Guangfeng-Yushan Branch'. This is the same provincial roster that separately and exactly matches P4786 (item 23, 赣州南支线（会昌-寻乌段）), P4788 (item 21, 赣州南支线（信丰-瑞金段）) and P5888 (item 35, 万载-铜鼓支线) as single combined items each -- so the list's convention for a genuinely single/combined project is to give it ONE item number, which sharpens the significance of Guangfeng and Yushan getting TWO. Combined with the already-known tension that no source has ever been found giving a single length/status figure for a combined 'Guangfeng-Yushan Branch' as GEM models it (batch_07's Length/FuelSource both UNRESOLVED, Status only 'unclear'), this raises a genuine existence/classification question: is GEM's P5887 actually two separate provincial branches merged into one row+route, or one row correctly representing a single physical branch that the province's own roster happens to list in two administrative pieces (Guangfeng District and Yushan County each getting a line item for their own portion of one continuous pipe)?
